- Christine is free (her next busy period starts at 12:00).
- Janice is free and this time is before 13:00, accommodating her preference to not meet after 13:00.
- Bobby is free (his next busy period starts at 12:00).
- Elizabeth is free (her busy period ends at 11:30 and the next starts at 13:00).
- Tyler is free (his busy period ends at 11:00 and the next starts at 12:00).
- Edward is free (his busy period ends at 11:00 and the next starts at 11:30).

No other 30-minute slot between 9:00 and 17:00 accommodates all schedules while respecting Janice's preference as well as this one. For example:
- Slots before 11:00 have conflicts with various participants (e.g., Elizabeth, Tyler, or Edward are busy).
- Slots after 11:30 until 14:00 have conflicts (e.g., Elizabeth or Edward are busy during lunch hours).
- Slots after 14:00 either have schedule conflicts (e.g., Christine or Bobby are busy around 14:30) or occur after 13:00, which Janice prefers to avoid.

Thus, the optimal time is Monday, 11:00 to 11:30.
